note: Ready: all 2 checks pass. 1 question about the original is still open.
last_reply:

Now the actual removal and export.The export came out at 19.6 seconds: 28 seconds of clips minus the 8.4 removed. Checking how the timeline looks after the cut.Yes, you can now cut out stretches.
